title: Sources for algebraic elimination and further proof theory
details: For later algebraic applications, Marker’s Model Theory II: Quantifier Elimination (2020-10-14), slides 1–13, remains an orientation source; inspect the actual algebraic prerequisites and proofs before adoption. Obtain complete sources for sequent-calculus interpolation of equality-free first-order proofs, intuitionistic first-order interpolation and varying-domain completeness with logical equality or beyond the current countability hypotheses, logical-equality-preserving cut and Harrop transformations with exact witness provisos and general Herbrand extraction with quantified contraction. The general proof in Buss’s 1995 Herbrand article has a contraction defect; its separate weak leading-existential fragment does not justify the unrestricted theorem. Select sources for quantitative cut bounds and strong normalization and confluence for a specified local natural-deduction reduction relation. For arithmetic Friedman applications, inspect sources for translated native HA axiom preservation, with finite parameter closure and protected free parameters, and for a precisely stated Friedman-based arithmetic conservativity theorem. Select further constructive arithmetic sources for realizability, numerical existence and disjunction extraction, provably total functions, primitive recursive arithmetic and ordinal analysis.
